name: trakt-mcp
description: Explore Trakt movies, shows, calendars, and lists; manage your watchlist, history, ratings, and collection with explicit write permission.

interface.longDescription: Companion for Trakt is an independent integration built by SwackTech LLC. It uses Trakt but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt. Connect your own Trakt account to search movies and shows, get personalized recommendations, review your viewing history and profile, browse public and personal lists, and check upcoming episodes and releases. With write permission, it creates and edits your lists and updates your watchlist, ratings, history, and collection, but only when you ask, and it reads the change back. Read-only connections stay read-only.
defaultPrompt: Find three movies from my Trakt recommendations.
Show my upcoming episodes for the next seven days.
Create a private list called Rainy Sunday and add Arrival (2016).
